verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a prompt-driven design/prototyping generator with only basic layout controls (drag, resize, align, sliders for spacing/color) — there is no evidence of pen/path vector editing, boolean path operations, or precision alignment tooling akin to professional vector editors. Community feedback even notes the underlying output is HTML/CSS/JS, not vector paths, and code is not maintainable, reinforcing it's not a vector design tool.
